title: What the Trace Shows and What the Label Says: Auditing Behavioral Detectors in Agent Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2610.30491v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LLM agents are often evaluated by reducing execution traces to labels such as final-answer correctness, tool verification, and fault propagation. These labels are measurements produced by parsers, behavioral detectors, and harness rules, and they may not fully capture what the trace shows. We study this in a tool-use setting built on GSM8K, where agents call a calculator whose outputs are occasionally corrupted, giving clear ground truth for what the tool returned, what the model later used, and what the detectors reported. We audit three trace-level detectors across six production models and 30 problems per model. Final correctness, visible re-verification, and fault propagation can disagree in systematic ways. translated_title: 轨迹所示与标签所言：审计智能体评估中的行为检测器
translated_abstract: 大语言模型智能体通常通过将执行轨迹简化为最终答案正确性、工具验证和错误传播等标签来进行评估。这些标签是由解析器、行为检测器和评估框架规则产生的度量结果，它们可能无法完整捕捉轨迹所显示的内容。我们在基于GSM8K构建的工具使用场景中研究这一问题，其中智能体会调用一个输出偶尔被损坏的计算器，这为工具返回了什么、模型后续使用了什么以及检测器报告了什么提供了明确的真值参照。我们在六个生产级模型上、每个模型30道题目，审计了三个轨迹级检测器。最终正确性、可见的重新验证和错误传播之间可能以系统性的方式出现不一致。一个关键的失败模式是静默的工具输出覆盖：计算器返回了一个被损坏的值，但模型后续在没有再次调用工具的情况下使用了另一个（通常是正确的）值，因此坏值停止了传播，而（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该研究通过在GSM8K上构建包含损坏计算器输出的工具使用场景，审计了三个轨迹级行为检测器，发现最终正确性、可见重新验证与错误传播等标签会系统性不一致，并揭示了“静默工具输出覆盖”这一关键失败模式——即模型在不重新调用工具的情况下使用了与损坏输出不同的值。
en_tdlr: This paper audits three trace-level behavioral detectors in agent evaluation using a GSM8K-based tool-use setting with corrupted calculator outputs, finding that final correctness, visible re-verification, and fault propagation labels can systematically disagree, and revealing a key failure mode of silent tool-output override where the model uses a different, often correct, value without re-calling the tool.
